title: Add Onboarding Tour
content: Create onboarding tour. Overlay: fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50. Spotlight: cutout around target element, border-radius matching element. Tooltip: absolute positioned near target, bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl p-4 max-w-xs. Content: step title, description, step indicator (1 of 5). Navigation: Previous, Next, Skip buttons. Arrow: pointing to target element.

variants.simple: Create guided product tour with tooltips and steps.

variants.advanced: Create comprehensive product tour system. Tour definition: array of steps with target selector, content, position, actions. Spotlight: highlight target element with dark overlay around it, smooth transition between targets, optional pulsing animation. Tooltip: positioned automatically (prefer bottom, flip if necessary), arrow pointing to target, title, description, optional image/gif. Progress: step indicator dots, "Step X of Y" text. Navigation: Back, Next (or Continue), Skip Tour buttons, keyboard navigation (arrows, Escape to skip). Target scrolling: scroll element into view before showing tooltip, account for fixed headers. Target highlighting: z-index boost for target element, optional border or glow effect. Interactive steps: require user to perform action (click button, fill input) before advancing. Conditional steps: skip steps based on user state or feature flags. Branching: different paths based on user choices. Persistence: save progress in localStorage, resume where left off, mark completed tours. Triggers: start on first visit, on feature release, manually via help menu. Completion: celebration animation, next steps suggestions, don't show again option. Multiple tours: different tours for different features or user types. Analytics: track completion rate, drop-off points, time per step. Mobile: adapt tooltip size and position, disable tour on very small screens. Accessibility: focus management, screen reader announcements, respect reduced motion preference.
